text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe puts in an excellent performance at the Japan Cup. Although she ran while grappling with misgivings about whether her friend is actually an evil witch…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy sees no signs of Manhattan Cafe's running being cursed. On the contrary, she says that Manhattan Cafe was "incandescent."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the moments after the race, Manhattan Cafe glimpses that blinding light once again—shining this time where her friend's painstaking guidance has brought her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon announces that, with her hiatus officially over, she'll be returning to racing and intends to compete in the Arima Kinen. Yesterday's friend has become today's foe.
